newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on pre-election rally.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on pre-election rally.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Thursday in a rally before the February 3 general elections, but profit-taking by speculators trimmed early gains, dealers said.
"There was heavy buying because (pro-business leader of Pakistan Muslim League party) Nawaz Sharif has clear chances of winning the elections," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
"But profit-taking in active scrips trimmed the gains. The index is likely to dip on profit-taking on Sunday."
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 22.06 points, or 1.46 percent, to end at 1,534.21.
